featured_reviews.name: Shweta Nag
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with my experience with Date The Ramp, and I feel compelled to share it so other brides don’t go through the stress I faced on my wedding day.
I had booked my wedding lehenga in 23 August 2025, a beautiful pink outfit that I instantly loved. At the time of booking, I was charged ₹10,000, and the team assured me that all damages (missing diamonds, loose threads, etc.) would be fixed before my wedding on 5th December.
However, when I went to pick up my dress one day before the wedding, I was shocked.
Most of the diamonds were missing on both the blouse and the lehenga
Threads were loose and hanging
The fitting was uncomfortably tight
The outfit looked worn out and completely unprepared
I had already purchased all my jewellery and accessories to match this dress, so changing the outfit last minute wasn’t possible. The manager told me the previous staff had left and promised they would fix the diamonds and make it “perfect.” I even compromised and requested them to fix at least the front area, especially where the yellow diamond moulds looked empty.
They assured me everything would be done.
But on my wedding day, when I opened the dress around 3 PM, the diamonds were still missing, and the outfit looked shabby and unfinished. I cannot express how stressful and heartbreaking it was to face this just hours before my wedding. They completely ruined the look of my wedding outfit while still charging a premium amount.
Overall, this was an extremely unprofessional and upsetting experience. I would not recommend Date The Ramp to anyone, especially brides who are trusting them with important occasions.

I recently bought my wedding sherwani from Kora, and I genuinely had one of the smoothest experiences. Lucky Singh and Uday were absolutely amazing, right from the moment I walked in, they guided me with patience, suggested what would suit me best, and helped me finalise the perfect outfit.

They really understood what I was looking for and made sure the fitting, design, and look were just right. Kora has a great collection of wedding wear, so it made choosing fun rather than stressful.

Really happy with my purchase and the experience overall. Highly recommend visiting Kora if you’re shopping for wedding outfits!

featured_reviews.name: Ashok Khemka
featured_reviews.review_text:
Excellent experience at Kora Borivali store earlier in the month. Superb collection , great hospitality with smiling faces made the difference. Kundan from store stayed late and kept on saying don’t worry and allowed us to take our time in finalising our Kurta set with Bundi. It was our anniversary and wanted something special. He kept on showing and making us take trial tirelessly. Me and my son were able to select our sets and he also helped us in urgent alteration in few days as we were pressed for time. Kudos to the store , recommend if need exclusive atuff.
Looking forward to more visit in future and purchasing with Kundan.

featured_reviews.name: bhavesh kapdule
featured_reviews.review_text: Had a wonderful shopping experience thanks to Suraj! He was very helpful, patient, and really understood what I was looking for. His knowledge of traditional outfits and attention to detail made the whole process smooth and enjoyable. He suggested styles that perfectly matched my taste and occasion, and I ended up with a beautiful outfit I absolutely love. Truly great service—highly recommend asking for Suraj if you visit!

featured_reviews.name: Mugdha Bapat
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had a wonderful experience shopping at Kora, Borivali! The store has a fantastic collection -  from elegant traditional pieces to modern festive wear, every outfit is crafted with such detail and quality.

A special mention to Kundan, who made the entire experience so smooth and enjoyable. He was incredibly patient, kind, and genuinely helpful throughout - taking the time to understand what we were looking for, suggesting options that suited our style, and never rushing the process. He made sure every fit and detail was perfect, and that kind of attentiveness really stood out.

If you’re looking for a place that combines great designs with even better service, Kora Borivali is definitely worth visiting.

featured_reviews.name: Rishith Rambhia
featured_reviews.review_text: No place like Popin for all your wedding wears. Anything you take on rent from here feels as good as new. The collection is just mind blowing. The staff is very friendly and will recommend the best. The place is huge and with multiple varieties. I have stopped purchasing wedding wears after being introduced to Popin. Highly recommended for your wedding wears.

featured_reviews.name: Utkarsh Singh
featured_reviews.review_text:
The collection of outfits is quite good, and you can find some excellent rental options for both men and women. The rental charges are on the higher side compared to a few other rental shops I visited in Borivali, but the variety and quality of dresses are decent.

My biggest concern was the behavior of one of the reception staff members, she might be in 30s. She was quite rude and unprofessional in the way she spoke to customers. If you have any issue, request a change, or need some flexibility, don’t expect much support. The tone and attitude made the entire experience unpleasant. It felt more like a rigid “these are the rules, take it or leave it” approach, even in situations where accommodating the customer would not have caused any inconvenience to the store.

Thankfully, there was another senior lady who stepped in and helped resolve our issue, making the situation much easier to handle. In fact, without her assistance, I would have rated this place much lower.

Apart from this one staff member, the rest of the team was polite and helpful. The dress collection is good, but customer serviceespecially at the reception,needs significant improvement.

featured_reviews.name: Nehal Mehta
featured_reviews.review_text:
We rented both men's and ladies' wedding outfits from Popin for our friend's wedding and had a wonderful experience. Our association with Popin goes back more than three decades. When our children were young, we used to rent fancy dress costumes from them for school events and competitions now they are not provide fancy dresses.

Over the years, we have always found their collection, service, and quality to be reliable and impressive. The outfits were well-maintained, stylish, and fit perfectly for the occasion.

Because of the trust and satisfaction we have built with Popin over the years, we are now planning to rent wedding attire for our daughter's wedding in January 2027 as well.

We highly recommend Popin to anyone looking for quality wedding wear and costume rentals with excellent customer service.

featured_reviews.name: Rohit sawant
featured_reviews.review_text: “I’m extremely happy with my experience at this wedding dress rental service. They have an amazing variety of wedding dresses to suit different styles and budgets. The quality of the dress was excellent—clean, well-maintained, and elegant. The staff was patient, professional, and helped me find the perfect fit. It made my special day even more memorable. Would definitely recommend!”

featured_reviews.name: vashishth Chowmal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Popin made my wedding experience so much easier and stylish. Their collection of outfits is truly impressive — elegant, trendy, and perfect for every wedding function. I was able to rent premium-quality clothes at a fraction of the price, and the fitting was spot on.

The staff was extremely helpful, guiding me through options and ensuring everything was ready on time. The pickup and return process was smooth and completely hassle-free.

If you’re looking to rent wedding outfits without compromising on style or quality, Popin is definitely the best choice! Highly recommended.

featured_reviews.name: Jay Soni
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a fabulous experience renting a garba costume from Popin for a recent event in Mumbai. The quality of the clothes was excellent, and the entire process, from selection to fitting, was made smooth by the supportive and cooperative staff. (Bhumi) The rental prices were also very reasonable, I would highly recommend Popin to anyone looking for high-quality,  garba outfits..

featured_reviews.name: B/34 /Khushal pandya
featured_reviews.review_text:
recently bought my farewell court from this store, and honestly, the experience was amazing. The quality of the fabric, the perfect fitting, and the attention to detail really stood out. The staff was very helpful and guided me well in choosing the right style and size.

Wearing it on such a special occasion made me feel confident and well-dressed. Highly recommended for anyone looking for formal wear with great quality and service!
